tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, header bar, anything set above the page.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Footer, code blocks, quiet bands that group a section.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken and every -soft fill (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, venues, captions, metadata on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken (5.2:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative rules between list items and around cards. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (buttons, inputs, the language toggle); 3.2:1 or better on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: strait
tokens.usage: The brand colour, after the Bosphorus. Links, primary button fill, the pattern mark's discs. As text it reads on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunken and strait-soft (5.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: strait-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind strait tags and highlighted panels. Text on it: ink or strait.

tokens.name: on-strait
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a strait fill (7.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Accent. The pattern mark's squares, the current item in navigation, one emphasis per view. As text it reads on paper and paper-raised (5.4:1 or better), and on clay-soft (4.5:1).

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind clay tags. Text on it: ink or clay.

tokens.name: on-clay
tokens.usage: Text on a clay fill (5.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Decorative fill only: cover blocks, illustration, chart highlight. Never text, never the only carrier of meaning (2.2:1 on paper in light).

tokens.name: ochre-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind ochre tags and "new" notes. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 5.9:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home page hero only, once per site.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I study how young children learn mathematics and how technology can help teachers teach it.
styles.usage: The first paragraph of a page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ğ, ş, ı, İ, ö, ü, ç all set cleanly in Newsreader.
styles.usage: All running text. Keep lines within the measure token.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: What comes next in the pattern?

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, the active nav item.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small label above a title: funder, project type, year. Set in uppercase with CSS, write it in normal case.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: DOIs, code, data labels, AB-AB pattern notation.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside tags and between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its metadata.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button side padding; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on mobile; pattern pitch on the cover.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags, cards. The system is nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Images and figures.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Only the language toggle and the pattern mark's discs.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page grid.
